summary: Iteration 62 — AI character call-event pill labels + voice-note caption removal + Cloudinary .mp3 playback fix. All 7 backend pytest cases passed (POST /call-event start/end variants, chronological order via /thread, last_call_ended_at state write, regression that text /send still produces an ai reply with system rows present in history, and /voice-turn still returns {reply, audio_url}). Web UI verified: call-event system messages render as CENTERED PILLS with data-testid='aichar-call-label' (NOT normal left/right bubbles); AI voice-note message renders an AudioBubble with data-testid='voice-note' and the text caption is hidden INSIDE the chat thread; the <audio> src is rewritten from a Cloudinary .webm URL to .mp3 (playableUrl works). No regressions observed.

issues: The sidebar last-message PREVIEW shows the raw caption text of an audio message (e.g. 'this caption should NOT ap...') instead of a '🎤 Voice note' placeholder. Inside the actual chat thread the caption is correctly hidden under the AudioBubble (as required). Minor polish: consider filtering `media_type === 'audio'` in the threads-list preview too.

action_items: (Optional/polish) In the AI-characters threads list (left sidebar in /messages), when the last message is media_type=='audio', render a '🎤 Voice note' label instead of leaking the raw transcript/caption. Not blocking — inside the thread view the caption is already correctly hidden.
critical_code_review_comments: ai_characters.py:1356 call-event endpoint cleanly reuses _msg_out and sets last_call_ended_at only on 'end' — good.
_tline (ai_characters.py:845) safely renders role=='system' rows as '[text]' so the transcript assembled for the LLM reply loop never crashes when a call-event row is present (verified end-to-end).
VoiceNote.jsx:21 playableUrl correctly handles both .webm→.mp3 rewrite AND Cloudinary URLs without an extension (appends .mp3). Local blob URLs are passed through untouched.
AiCharacterChat.jsx:241 hides captions for ANY audio message (both user and AI). This is exactly what the spec asked for.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create a single TEST_Caller_<hex> character and delete it + its messages/state on teardown. UI run created TEST_UICallBot + injected one Cloudinary audio ai message via Mongo for the src-rewrite inspection, then deleted the character + messages/state afterwards.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Call-event endpoint is at POST /api/ai-characters/{id}/call-event with CallEventBody {event: 'start'|'end', duration}. System messages are stored with role='system' and appear in /thread between user/ai rows. The frontend renders them as centered pills (data-testid='aichar-call-label'); any audio message in the thread hides its caption and routes through VoiceNote.playableUrl which rewrites Cloudinary extensions to .mp3 for iOS Safari compatibility. The AI-character threads-list sidebar still shows the raw caption text as a preview — minor polish only, not functional.
